product.olivetti-snx-160-r.summary: The high-availability SNX 160 retained the option of a second processor.
product.olivetti-snx-160-r.history: Olivetti offered the 160/R as the high-availability SNX 160 variant. The guide records that the SNX 160/RS replaced it in April 1995.
product.olivetti-snx-160-r.architecture: Drives could be replaced while the server was running. The R version combines the IRON case with the GO2044 SCSI RAID controller for RAID 1 or 5.
product.olivetti-snx-160-r.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160-r.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
